Since the weight on C equals the sum of the other two weights (3 = 1 + 2), the minimum is at P = C.

For any point P, the triangle inequality gives

AP + 2BP + 3CP = (AP + CP) + 2(BP + CP) ≥ AC + 2·BC.

Equality holds when P = C. The minimum value is therefore

AC + 2·BC = 2022 + 2·2023 = 6068.

ANSWER: 6068
